title: Brutalist Style
content: Apply brutalist aesthetics with bold, raw visual elements. Use heavy black borders (border-4 border-black), stark contrasts between black and bright colors. Implement oversized typography with font-black weight and dramatic size differences. Use unconventional layouts with overlapping elements and asymmetric positioning. Add harsh shadows (shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]). Avoid rounded corners - use sharp edges throughout. Include raw, unpolished textures. Break traditional alignment rules intentionally.

variants.simple: Apply bold, raw design with heavy borders and stark contrasts.

variants.advanced: Apply brutalist aesthetics with bold, raw visual elements. Use heavy black borders (border-4 border-black) with stark contrasts between black and bright accent colors. Implement oversized typography (text-6xl to text-9xl) with font-black weight and dramatic size differences. Use unconventional layouts with overlapping elements (negative margins, absolute positioning) and asymmetric grids. Add harsh shadows (shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]) for flat 3D effect. Keep sharp edges throughout - no rounded corners. Include raw textures via CSS patterns or SVG backgrounds. Break traditional alignment rules intentionally but maintain logical content flow for screen readers. IMPORTANT: Despite visual chaos, ensure tab order is logical, maintain proper heading hierarchy, and keep interactive elements clearly identifiable. Add visible focus states that work with bold aesthetic. Consider motion-sensitive users when adding jarring transitions. Use semantic HTML to maintain accessibility despite unconventional visual presentation.
